title: Decision: Parse and validate request parameters BEFORE subscribing to events
description:
In kithd events.rs events_handler (lines 106-129), parameter validation happens early, before any resource allocation:
  1. Auth check (line 107) — reject if not Owner
  2. Parse closeafter (lines 112-118) — reject if invalid
  3. Parse types filter (lines 121-129) — reject if invalid
  4. Extract/validate Last-Event-ID (lines 134-147)
  5. THEN subscribe to broadcast (line 152)

This is correct defense-in-depth:
  - Invalid requests fail fast without consuming channel capacity
  - Broadcast channel subscription happens only for valid requests
  - If any parameter is malformed, client gets 400 before draining resources
  - Last-Event-ID parsing is lenient (invalid format → silent ignore, no 400) but is still validated before subscribe

Order matters: return before subscribe prevents wasted work on invalid requests.
